name: mpf-mixed-arithmetic-audit
description: Static detection of arithmetic mixing an mpmath value with a float64-sourced one. Sits between the value-level padding ratchet (blind once a float64 is multiplied by anything exact) and the construction-level mpf(<float>) gate (blind because no mpf() call is involved). Advisory: high-recall candidates for agent verdict.
